newsitem.title: USA: Amrion sees Q4, year EPS beating estimates.
newsitem.headline: Amrion sees Q4, year EPS beating estimates.

text.p: Amrion Inc said on Wednesday its preliminary sales and and earnings results would exceed analysts' estimates for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 1996.
The First Call mean earnings estimate for the fourth quarter was $0.23 per share versus the $0.18 per share it earned in the year-ago fourth quarter.
Preliminary, unaudited results indicate that both 1996 sales and earnings were up about 40 percent, Amrion said.
The company said its preliminary 1996 sales results were about $54 million, compared with $39 million in 1995.
The company said it did not expect any significant year-end audit adjustments.
